content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the SHS Maharashtra Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SHS Maharashtra Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in SHS Maharashtra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for various posts including Chief Digital and AI Officer, Project Lead, Senior Software Developer, and Software Support Engineer in SHS Maharashtra Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for SHS Maharashtra Various Posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for SHS Maharashtra Various Posts is Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for SHS Maharashtra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for SHS Maharashtra Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 18 August 2026. Candidates must report on this date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts under SHS Maharashtra Recruitment 2026 is 55 years. There might be age relaxation for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for the posts in SHS Maharashtra?
faq.answer: The salary for the posts ranges from ₹53,764 to ₹500,000 per month, depending on the specific position. The Chief Digital and AI Officer post offers the highest salary.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications for the Chief Digital and AI Officer post?
faq.answer: For the Chief Digital and AI Officer post, a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/IT with 15 years of experience in digital transformation, IT, AI, or digital health is required. A Master's degree is preferred.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee for SHS Maharashtra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. For General/OBC candidates, it is Rs. 750/-, and for SC/ST candidates, it is Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, category certificate, and passport-size photographs for the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for SHS Maharashtra Various Posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for SHS Maharashtra Various Posts primarily involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates will be assessed based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be downloaded from the official website of State Health Society Maharashtra (nhm.maharashtra.gov.in). A direct link is also provided in the Important Links section of this article.
